limitations: All operator credentials/accounts are synthetic and disposable. No real operator, private deployment, admin OCI image, registry publication, external monitor or public/store release is established; N03-05/N07-05 are separate gates.

Authenticated desktop/mobile flows use a local development frontend and actual test API/DB. Production frontend smoke uses local HTTP, validates nonce hydration/headers/denials and has no operator/TLS backend. This is not an authorized private-ingress or production MFA rollout.
Mobile is360px Chromium emulation only; no Android/iOS binary or physical evidence and no distribution-context change.

Metrics expose only current process counters/gauges, not historical queries, rate/health/capacity or deployed source-revision qualification. Ten/thirty-second freshness and clock-skew rules are local gateway policy; richer N08/N07-04 work remains.

No new complete backend599-case/browser-six-group run is claimed here. API/portal/shared-package/SQL bytes and old dependency snapshots are unchanged from3faeae3; scoped26 admin,328 unit,81 governance and final8 admin-browser executions are fresh. Historical source-specific results retain their scope.

Initial missing module/CSP/consumer-list/type/harness failures and generated-shim parity failures remain in private logs. Generated Next type shim remains on disk and out of tracked admin source; actual clean generated-input typecheck/typegen and runtime parity pass.

N04-02 remains BLOCKED_EXTERNAL: genuine release/App setup/actual bot PR+hosted Quality missing. Known hosted baseline cadence/enforcement finding remains unresolved; owner review is not branch protection. Raw artifacts remain private local until owner cleanup, not off-host archives.
